Part A requires choosing the governing principles (momentum conserved, KE not conserved when carts stick) to evaluate a claim. Part C requires proportional reasoning with a changed mass ratio (fraction of KE remaining = m/(m+M), so the fraction lost rises from 2/3 to 4/5).
